corrections.description: First pass attributes extensive cross experiments to Blyth. They are Bashford P2–9; Blyth P1 only, Darwin later pencil questions third voice.
First pass calls enclosure unavailable.1525 is preserved and independently accepted in37; same-author cover/enclosure not QA.

First pass says questionnaire source not present and expands price-setting to publishers. Full quoted question appears in apparatus; Charles body specifically concerns booksellers. Original witness pending.
Named French works are not all merely reported: Souvenirs expressly fully read, whereas requested experimental details and horse pamphlet remain unavailable.
Prior full source says rock specimens not yet sent, not merely not yet reached Geological Society.

summary: Eighteen targets: three incoming, fourteen attributed Darwin documents, one unavailable-body institutional proxy. Fifteen fresh full-source readings, seventeen packet records plus extra1525 reused with exact provenance. No new accepted graph edge; Parker circular is a concrete external witness follow-up, not a synthetic missing question. Source voice, date and raw-rendering defects retained.
